title: Relative graded maps into tensor powers of a line module
statement:
Let $Z,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $h:Z\to S$ any morphism, $A$ an affine-basis quasi-coherent graded $\mathcal O_S$-algebra as in [def-nagata-relative-proj], and $L$ an $\mathcal O_Z$-module. Use tensor powers [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with $L^{\otimes0}=\mathcal O_Z$, and tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] with its canonical tensor-power comparison [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison]. Define a relative graded line map $\psi$ by additive maps $\psi_{V,n}:A(V)_n\to\Gamma(h^{-1}V,L^{\otimes n})$ for every affine open $V\subseteq S$ and $n\ge0$. Require $\psi_{V,n}(ra)=h^*(r)\psi_{V,n}(a)$, $\psi_{V,0}(1)=1$, and $\psi_{V,m+n}(ab)=\psi_{V,m}(a)\otimes\psi_{V,n}(b)$ under the canonical tensor-power isomorphism. For affine $V\subseteq V'$, require $\psi_{V,n}(a|_V)=\psi_{V',n}(a)|_{h^{-1}V}$. No condition $A_0=\mathcal O_S$, degree-one generation, finiteness or quasi-compactness is part of this data.

For a scheme morphism $j:W\to Z$ whose image lies over $V$, define $\psi$ evaluated on $W$ by pulling back the section $\psi_{V,n}(a)$ along the canonical section map and applying $j^*(L^{\otimes n})\simeq(j^*L)^{\otimes n}$. Define $\psi.\mathrm{GeneratesEverywhere}$ to mean that for every $x\in Z$ there are an affine $V$ with $h(x)\in V$, $n>0$, and $a\in A(V)_n$ such that the germ of $\psi_{V,n}(a)$ at $x$ is not in $\mathfrak m_x(L^{\otimes n})_x$. For invertible $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], this is the condition that the positive-degree generation locus is all of $Z$.

For $r:Z\to\operatorname{Proj}_S A$, define $\psi.\mathrm{IsCanonicalMap}(r)$ by $\pi\circ r=h$ together with the following chart condition. For every open immersion $j:W\to Z$, affine $V\subseteq S$ containing the image of $h\circ j$, trivialization $e:j^*L\simeq\mathcal O_W$, and ring homomorphism $\alpha:A(V)\to\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$ whose value on every $a\in A(V)_n$ is the evaluated section expressed in the $n$th power of $e$, whenever the image of the irrelevant ideal generates the unit ideal, require $r\circ j=i_V\circ\operatorname{Proj.fromOfGlobalSections}(\alpha)$. Here $i_V$ is the canonical relative-Proj chart embedding and the homogeneous-section construction, including its tensor-power trivializations, is the one in [def-trf-space-line-module-proj-input]. These are definitions, not an assertion of existence of $r$.
